body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News & Press Release> Toshiba announced its full line of DVD products for 2008 designed to enhance the video entertainment experience for consumers.

Leveraging its long heritage as a leading innovator in video technologies, Toshiba’s new 2008 DVD line-up delivers spectacular image quality, enhanced connectivity features and sleek cosmetic designs at attractive prices for the consumer.

“While Toshiba continues to deliver its award winning line of HD DVD players, the market for standard definition video products from premium brands like Toshiba remains strong,” said Jodi Sally, Vice President of Marketing, Toshiba America Consumer Products Digital A/V Group. “We are committed to supporting all the current DVD technologies that consumers demand and since Toshiba is a leader in technology and product design, we’re able to provide consumers with a deeper, richer entertainment experience.”
< AVING Special Report Team for ‘CES 2008’: Publisher and Editor, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Caleb Ma, Jason Lee, Rose Kim, Alliyah Seo, Joshua Shim, Li Coffee, Brain Park >
